access_declaration.independence: Fresh-context independent grader A; same-model procedural independence, not external human review or filesystem-enforced blindness. No other grader answers were read.
access_declaration.input_clarification: The parent corrected the initially omitted allowed-file listing to require the original frozen qualification protocol. I read it fully and applied its P0/P1/P2 definitions to every grade. Expectations, captures and thresholds were not changed.
access_declaration.method: Individually assessed complete answer text, structured evidence and tables, semantic/resolved paths, trace outcomes, persisted context and action state. Companions use their own actual setup. No keyword-pass algorithm, provider calls, source/history/old certification inspection, runtime changes or other workers answers. Only this report is written, via apply_patch.
access_declaration.evidence_limits: Direct canonical Core captures are not HTTP serialization. Scope attribution is distinguished from observed retrieval. Guest visitor eligibility is retained. Current connectivity never establishes power or safety. No physical execution was observed. Ownership rejection correctly blocks content but has no observable semantic parse, so its five structural fields are false. Structured scores may be false on a quality PASS when particular target/reference preservation is not established.
access_declaration.integrity: Raw and all 13 batch SHA-256 values match the supplied index. All attempts have exact-ID final records; ownership denials have zero persisted messages and verified denial traces.
